title: What HotStuff Internals Is All About
description: The modern BFT: linear communication, pipelined phases (Libra/Diem lineage).. This database covers HotStuff Internals with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. Consensus is agreement despite failures; it's the core of distributed systems.
definition: HotStuff Internals — The modern BFT: linear communication, pipelined phases (Libra/Diem lineage).
key_points: Consensus is agreement despite failures; it's the core of distributed systems.
Raft is understandable consensus; use it.
Paxos is the original; harder but equivalent.
Majority quorums are the mechanism; overlap ensures safety.
